meaning: Pump operation error: the pump has failed.
diySteps: Try to start the cycle again
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If the error still occurs, Samsung says to request service through its Support Center. Not the same as Samsung washer 3C, which is a motor error. Not the same as dishwasher 3E, which is a high temperature water supply. Read the characters on the display.
sourceTitle: Samsung dishwasher is displaying an error code (Samsung Support)
